title: Song Pal Dance
style: Phonk-leaning rap with swung drums, gritty handclaps, and a bouncing low-end groove; verse rides sparse kicks and chopped vocal tags, pre-chorus strips to filtered snaps and a rising chant, chorus lands with stacked kid vocals and a punchy call-and-response hook. Corey’s lead is double-tracked with ad-lib panning, delay throws on the anchor phrase, and a few reversed swells into section turns. Dark, crisp, and playful in the mix., deep, rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey shares Songpal.ai
universal bilingual music
that where we meet

DJ Zyn Rose on the beat
The kids sing
Rapper Raffa Raps!

Free from style
Rap Rap Rap

[Pre-Chorus]
Corey A I
Song Pal A I!
Song pal like a pen pal
unreal, listen and feel

I sing aloud
you hear my sound
so dear
sing it back

[Chorus]
Song Pal A I!
Song Pal A I!
we sing pal!

digger deep
feel unreal
lay that rythm down

spin it around
upside down
like a clown

without a frown
do that dance
or just a glance

a song pal
we sing pal!
(we sing pal!)
